graphs.title: The cardiac output rises as the heart rate rises.
graphs.label: Cardiac output

sentences: Compare a heart rate of 40 beats/min with 180 beats/min at the same stroke volume.
title: How much blood does the heart pump?
goal: See how the heart rate and the stroke volume set the amount of blood pumped each minute.
note: Cardiac output is the volume of blood the heart pumps in one minute. It is the heart rate multiplied by the stroke volume, the volume pumped by one beat. A mL per minute figure is shown in litres per minute.

concept_check.question: During exercise the heart rate rises and the stroke volume stays the same. What happens to the cardiac output?
concept_check.explanation: Cardiac output is the heart rate times the stroke volume, so a higher heart rate with the same stroke volume gives a higher output.
